visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A grainy, low-light shot shows a person in a pink dress attempting to jump over a white A-frame sign on a paved area at night but falling over it. (2) The scene cuts to a bright outdoor park during the day; a young woman with long black hair, wearing a striped turtleneck and black shorts, crawls out from under a pink game board on the green grass. She stands up and adjusts her hair. (3) She smiles at the camera while standing in the park with trees in the background, then pulls a large black tactical gear case into the frame. (4) Close-up of the woman as she introduces the case, which features a 'DMZ RECON' logo and yellow hazard tape markings. (5) She unlatches the case and pulls out a black baseball cap, showing it to the lens. (6) She holds up a golden game card with text and a skull logo, followed by two metallic dog tags on chains. (7) She displays a large grey zip-up hoodie with graphics of game characters on the back, then shows a folded black and yellow towel labeled 'CODM'. (8) The visual shifts to dynamic game footage showing digital character animations and cinematic battle scenes. (9) Back to the park, the woman puts on the hoodie and poses. (10) More game footage follows, featuring characters from 'Street Fighter' like Chun-Li and Ryu in combat poses. (11) The woman jumps excitedly in the park, waving her hand near her mouth in a playful gesture. (12) Finally, she sits behind the open case on the grass, holding the hat and waving goodbye to the camera as variety-show style text appears.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main female creator in the daylight scenes, 1 female figure falling in the intro night clip.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian woman with long, dark, wavy hair, wearing a brown and black horizontal striped turtleneck top and black denim shorts with black boots.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A lush green lawn with various leafy trees and shrubs under soft daylight; intercut with high-fidelity 3D game environments including urban ruins and digital arenas.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a sharp, percussive thud and metallic rattle as the subject falls. Immediately, a high-tempo electronic-cinematic BGM swells with a heavy 4/4 beat. (2) A male narrator begins a fast-paced, high-arousal delivery in Mandarin, layered over the music. A female voice laughs briefly in the background. (3) Distinct mechanical clicks and metallic snaps signal the opening of a hard tactical case. (4) Crinkly plastic rustling and fabric friction sounds occur as items are pulled out. (5) The male narrator's pitch rises during the item reveal, emphasizing '6週年生日快樂'. (6) Deep synthesized 'whoosh' sounds and metallic impact SFX accentuate the transition to game footage. (7) The female speaker's vocal track becomes dominant at the end with high-pitched, excited cheering and rising intonation contours.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Introduction -> Unboxing -> Feature Showcase -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To celebrate and promote the 6th anniversary of Garena Call of Duty Mobile. The video uses a popular social media influencer to unbox a limited edition gift box, highlighting physical merchandise and new in-game modes/collaborations (DMZ mode, Street Fighter) to drive user engagement and game logins.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of the product case, logos, and promotional subtitles detailing anniversary events and giveaways.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-energy promotional content combining real-life unboxing with gameplay montages to appeal to mobile gamers.
